bugs.title: Reclaim stale bot task labels (cleanup.yml) fails with JSON parse error caused by a trailing comma left after JSONC comment-stripping
bugs.notes: Seeded from sweep prompt. Root cause per prompt: scripts/reclaim-stale-task-labels.mjs kvNamespaceId() strips block+line comments from bot/wrangler.bot-a.jsonc then JSON.parse fails at position 534 line 31 col 1 because a trailing comma remains after the 'triggers' object with nothing following it before the closing brace. Fixes required: (1) remove that trailing comma in bot/wrangler.bot-a.jsonc (and bot/wrangler.bot-b.jsonc if same pattern), (2) make kvNamespaceId() (and any other scripts/ file parsing .jsonc the same way) robust to JSONC trailing commas — either strip trailing commas before } or ] or use an already-available JSONC parser (check package.json first, avoid adding new deps), (3) add a test/assertion that both wrangler .jsonc files parse successfully via that helper, (4) verify script runs end-to-end (at minimum kvNamespaceId() no longer throws). | in_progress: confirmed trailing comma on line 25 after 'triggers' object with only comment lines (blanked by stripper) between it and closing brace on line 31 — matches reproduction. Starting fixes.

bugs.title: Shadow Clones should not attempt to deploy a Cloudflare Worker — skip deploy-bots.yml deploy steps entirely on clones
bugs.notes: Seeded from sweep prompt. .github/workflows/deploy-bots.yml currently runs wrangler deploy on every clone push touching bot/**, which fails loudly because clones have no CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN/ACCOUNT_ID and are not supposed to run their own Bot A/B Worker at all (clones share the central Bot A per §10). Fix by gating deploy jobs/steps with `if: github.repository == 'motionssalt/clipforge'` (same pattern as news-push.yml). Keep bot test suite (npm ci / npm test) running on all repos including clones. Reconsider bug-58/bug-68 failure-alert step — if deploy step no longer runs on clones, alert has nothing to fire on and can also be gated to central repo (verify no other step on clones can still fail in a way this alert must catch). Do not change central-repo behavior. Verify: on a clone, tests run + deploy shown as skipped in Actions UI + no Telegram deploy-blocked alert.
